summary: Peka Kroef is a third-generation, family-owned company in Odiliapeel, Netherlands, that processes fresh, chilled potato products: peeled and cut potatoes, baby potatoes, mash and gratins. It supplies retail, foodservice and the food industry, and has specialised in this work since 1970.
founded: 1970 (potato trading by Piet Kroef began in the 1950s)
products: Potato gratins, including vegan and sweet potato gratins
Plain peeled, cut, sliced and diced potatoes
Plain potatoes with no salt or additives for the food industry
markets: Retail, foodservice and the food industry
Western, Northern, Central and Southern Europe
24 countries listed on the markets page
facts: 90% of its potatoes are grown within a 60 km radius of Odiliapeel
SBTi-validated target: 54.7% cut in scope 1 and 2 emissions by 2035 vs 2024
Pack sizes range from 200 g to 5 kg
limitations: Processing capacity, revenue and employee numbers are not published on the pages read.
The roles of the Venray, Asten, Cuijk and Katwijk sites are not described.
Grower numbers, acreage, storage capacity and progress figures on sustainability targets are not given.
